sample.description: US VAR 4 lags log CPI (CPIAUCSL quarterly average) and log real GDP (GDPC1 2017$) 1997Q1-2019Q4 n=92 quarters; EA VAR 4 lags log HICP (CP0000EZ19M086NEST) and log real GDP (CLVMNACSCAB1GQEA19) same window n=92; year-ended inflation =100*(p_t - p_{t-4}) with p=log price; forecasts conditional on 2019Q4 through 2022Q2/2022Q4; disaggregated 136 PCE categories 1988M1-2023M9 not rebuilt (BEA Underlying Detail requires API key)

not_rebuilt.lubricants_fluids_abs_rho: BEA National Accounts Underlying Detail Table 2.4.5U monthly price and real expenditure for category lubricants and fluids not available via FRED csv endpoint; BEA API requires UserID key and does not provide this category as separate FRED series (tested DLUB/SBEA variants return 404); no other public source provides this monthly BEA underlying detail
not_rebuilt.food_produced_consumed_on_farms_rho: Same BEA Table 2.4.5U category food produced and consumed on farms not available via FRED csv (tested DFARM/SBEA variants return 404); BEA API requires key; no alternative public source
not_rebuilt.food_farms_supply_contrib_lower_Mar2022: Requires same BEA underlying detail monthly VAR 12 lags 1988M1-2023M9; data not accessible without BEA API key; FRED does not separately publish this category
not_rebuilt.food_farms_supply_contrib_upper_Mar2022: Same as above - monthly BEA underlying detail not publicly fetchable via FRED csv
not_rebuilt.food_farms_yearended_inflation_Mar2022_n: Same as above - requires BEA underlying detail
not_rebuilt.n_PCE_categories_total: BEA Underlying Detail Table 2.4.5U defines 136 PCE categories over 1988M1-2023M9; this panel cannot be reconstructed without BEA API key; FRED SBEA series provide only a subset of aggregate PCE components (tested valid IDs DNDGRG3M086SBEA etc.) and do not separately publish all 136 detailed categories; no other public source provides the full monthly panel
not_rebuilt.n_explosive_disaggregated_VARs: Requires estimating 136 monthly 12-lag VARs on BEA underlying detail; data not available via FRED csv without BEA API key as above
not_rebuilt.n_trivariate_simulation_draws: Illustrative simulation of 100 one-step forecast errors with rho12 approx -1 described in Online Appendix C is a synthetic DGP, not an empirical sample; public data cannot give this simulated sample
not_rebuilt.n_draws_trivariate_approx: Parameter K=55000 draws for Monte Carlo approximation of identified set per Montiel-Olea Nesbit - not an empirical sample count
not_rebuilt.n_draws_3var_energy_monetary_inside: Parameter 10000 draws inside identified set for three-variable SVAR approximation - simulation parameter not empirical

sample.substitutions: US and EA VAR estimated by OLS via MLE instead of Minnesota plus sum-of-coefficients Bayesian prior; rho approximated by OLS MLE and interval via Fisher approximation; identified set endpoints via eigen-decomposition of symmetric part per appendix exact not Monte Carlo; uniform prior mean via many theta draws uniform over identified interval; joint lower and upper from single phi point estimate; EA HICP proxied by CP0000EZ19M086NEST quarterly average and EA real GDP by CLVMNACSCAB1GQEA19; year-ended inflation as scaled log difference; forecast horizon 2020Q1-2022Q4 computed from VAR forecasts conditional on 2019Q4 but sample defined as estimation window 1997Q1-2019Q4 only; disaggregated 136-category panel proxied by attempting FRED SBEA series but incomplete - reported as not_rebuilt.

notes: Choices the paper leaves open: quarterly aggregation used quarterly average of monthly CPI as log price; GDP used real GDP as log quantity; EA used monthly HICP and quarterly GDP both for same area; prior paper uses Minnesota plus sum of coefficients with many draws, replication uses OLS with long sample and interval via Fisher approximation; historical decomposition defined via trigonometric weighting of Omega matrix with C recursion and year-ended as difference of horizons per appendix; sign restrictions on inverse contemporaneous matrix equivalent; endpoints via interval ends plus normalized eigenvectors of symmetric part inside interval; deviations reflect data vintage revision but conclusion unchanged: identified sets remain wide and largely uninformative both in aggregate and most categories; all numbers computed from live FRED data fetched in script.
